title: Suspicious Image Load related to IcedId
description: Use this query to locate suspicious load image events by rundll32.exe or regsvr32.exe, a behavior associated with IcedId, which can lead to ransomware.
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and ('Parent Process Name' in ('rundll32.exe', 'regsvr32.exe')) and ('Process Name' like '*.txt' or 'Process Name' like '*.pdf')
